strategy_roster.name: OCO Pending Orders
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy is driven only by manually configured live price triggers and has no historical indicator entry, so an impossible negative-price guard avoids fabricating one. OCO levels, Level1 quotes, arming state, and pip protections are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: 555 Scalper
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(10/30) and positive 14-bar ROC are explicit fallbacks for the source's LWMA, higher-timeframe momentum, and monthly MACD filters. Layered trades, pip stops, break-even, trailing, equity, and money exits are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: ADX Crossing
strategy_roster.notes: The +DI/-DI crossover is approximated by a five-bar price-momentum cross confirmed by ADX(50)>20; the inverse is the long exit. The documented absolute 1000/2000 price-unit protections and optional short handling are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Zone Recovery Formula
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) with positive one-bar momentum is a long-side proxy for the moving-average trend direction. The alternating recovery cycles, increasing volume, and floating-profit exit are stateful and omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Time EA
strategy_roster.notes: This is a time-of-day scheduler with no price/indicator signal, so an impossible negative-price guard is used rather than inventing a deterministic entry. Open/close times, position direction, daily state, and point protections are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: MSL EA
strategy_roster.notes: Prior 10-bar extremes are a direct proxy for the dynamic local support/resistance levels. Fractal offsets, tick distance, maximum positions, and the source's close-beyond-level details are not available in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Pending Orders By Time 2
strategy_roster.notes: A prior-range high break with positive momentum is a market-entry proxy for the scheduled buy-stop. Opening/closing hours, pending-order placement, tick offsets, trailing, and point-based stop/target values are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: 30-Minute Candle
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish current-candle direction and one-bar momentum proxy the documented gap/open comparison. The 30-minute clock, prior-candle access, one-minute-before-close exit, and reversal state are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Scalp RSI
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) ROC over 5 and 1 bars plus RSI<30 is an explicit proxy for the documented rapid-drop rules; -5/-3 are fallback movement levels. Tick stops, timing, position caps, and sell-side parameters are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Slope Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crossing back above its 20-bar mean from below 40 proxies the documented reversal toward balance. The documented 2% protective stop is retained; the 2x threshold and candle timeframe are not otherwise expressible.
